title: 硬件科技盈利：增长70-80%，AI需求能否持续？
speaker: James Wang

segments.en: What do you make of the old school tech, the software side of things here? I mean, we're trying to see if in May 1, deliver some turnaround here. Do you think we're seeing the bottoming out of those earnings now? Yeah, I think so. I think for the Internet sector, in particular, those that cater to the food delivery sector, I think earnings have both bottom out of the competition intensity has definitely come off.
segments.zh: 你怎么看传统科技，比如软件领域？我们想看看是否会出现转折。你认为盈利是否已经见底？是的，我认为互联网板块，尤其是外卖相关，盈利已经见底，竞争强度明显下降。

segments.en: That said, I think, you know, consumer sector itself is still a lackluster. So, putting a bit of upside with all the limit on how well they conform, but definitely, I think, from an earnings perspective, expenses, et cetera, that should bottom out. I should grow from here. So, all things considered, what's the best opportunity in the A-share market? In A-share market, to us, it remains tech. Hardware tech.
segments.zh: 不过，消费板块本身仍然平淡，限制了上行空间。但从盈利角度看，费用等应该已经见底，会从这里增长。综合考虑，A股市场最好的机会是什么？对我们来说，仍然是科技，硬件科技。

segments.en: I think, you know, the fact that the gum is now supporting the sector, that's always a good signal. Earnings growth is still very strong for the tech sector. It's 70 to 80% year-on-year growth for the hardware tech, or AI-related hardware tech sector. So, I think, relative to other sectors, this is still the best one.
segments.zh: 政策支持是积极信号。科技板块盈利增长依然强劲，硬件科技或AI相关硬件科技同比增长70-80%。相对其他板块，这仍然是最好的。

segments.en: We still like some of the basic material sector as well. That's better. That's done well, too. Yeah, they've done well.
segments.zh: 我们也看好一些基础材料板块，它们表现不错。
